name: Can I live in my house during a renovation?
description: Living in your home during renovation depends on the project's scope; it might be disruptive or require temporary relocation for major work.

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my house during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your house during a renovation depends heavily on the project's scope and the areas being renovated. For minor projects like a single room remodel, it might be feasible, though disruptive. For extensive renovations, such as a whole-house remodel or a major kitchen/bathroom renovation where essential utilities are affected for extended periods, it is often recommended to arrange alternative living arrangements for safety and comfort. We will discuss the feasibility and potential impact on your daily life during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during renovation depends on the project's scope; it might be disruptive or require temporary relocation for major work.
